High-Growth Nottinghamshire
In collaboration with Invest in Nottingham, we’ve examined the high-growth
ecosystem in Nottinghamshire: the top growing companies, and the investment
and institutions supporting them.

There are 482 active, high-growth companies in Nottinghamshire, which secured a total of £437m of
equity investment via 326 deals from 2012 to 2021. Technology sectors—particularly software-as-a-
service (SaaS) and life sciences—are among the top sectors within the region. 
Many of Nottinghamshire’s ambitious businesses are also rapidly growing their headcount,
together employing nearly 72k people; this shows the immense value that these dynamic companies
can provide to a region.
Learn more about Nottinghamshire’s high-growth ecosystem inside the report.

HENRY WHORWOOD
Henry leads our Research & Consultancy team, and is an expert on equity finance and high-growth
business. He's worked on briefs for the likes of Barclays, SyndicateRoom, Innovate UK, Smith &
Williamson and British Business Bank. He regularly gives presentations on market trends at events
around the UK.

Daniel conducts data manipulation and analysis as part of the Research & Consultancy team. He has a
background in business analysis and commercial copywriting in Australia and the UK, having worked
at The Sunday Times Fast Track, Oxford University Press, and advertising network MullenLowe Group.
